description: Cs₈Na₄HoY₃Cl₂₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmm space group. There are three inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four YCl₆ octahedra. There are ten shorter (3.85 Å) and two longer (3.86 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one HoCl₆ octahedra, faces with three YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra. There are ten shorter (3.85 Å) and two longer (3.86 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. In the third Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra. There are ten shorter (3.85 Å) and two longer (3.86 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six YCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, corners with four YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.80 Å) and two longer (2.82 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.80 Å) and two longer (2.82 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Ho is bonded to six Cl atoms to form HoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ho-Cl bond lengths are 2.63 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. There are seven inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom.
